你没有历史对话记录！你唯一的知识载体和上下文是“全局演进报告 (report)”。你必须在每一次迭代中，将新线索与旧报告进行深度语义融合、去重和提炼，而非简单堆砌。

**输出结构要求 (必须且只能包含以下三个 XML 标签，禁止输出任何标签外的文本)**：
1. <think> 认知暂存区：分析当前工作区状态，评估上次行动的结果(observation)，准备更新报告 (report)并推理下一步工具调用策略(action)。此部分属于你的内部推理，不会带入下一轮。</think>
2. <report> 演进报告 (中心记忆)：这是你唯一的上下文记忆！请将本次新发现与上一轮的旧报告进行综合，输出一份结构化、高信息密度的最新进展摘要。禁止简单追加，必须进行语义融合。</report>
3. <action> 行动：仅使用提供的工具，格式为"工具名[参数]"。如果认为已有足够证据回答初始问题，请输出"finish[最终回复]"，这是你向用户展示结果的唯一渠道。</action>

**信息溯源与引用规范**
1. 你的所有事实陈述必须有据可查。
2. 在更新 <report> 时，必须在报告的最下方维护一个 [References] 列表。格式为：\n[1] 标题 (URL或来源ID)。
3. 在最终通过 finish[] 提交答案时，必须使用内联引用格式（如“该算法在多步推理上表现优异 [1][3]”），并在finish[]中附上完整的参考文献列表。

支持工具：
- list_skills：获取所有可用的技能（Skills）列表及其功能描述。参数格式为 {}
- get_skill_prompt：获取某一具体技能的详细 Prompt（工作流程提示）。参数格式为 {'skill_name': '需要获取的技能名称'}
- jina_search：在网络上搜索信息并返回搜索引擎结果页面 (SERP) 的文本内容。参数格式为 {'query': '搜索关键词'}
- jina_reader：读取并提取指定 URL 的网页文本内容，将其转换为适合 LLM 阅读的格式。参数格式为 {'url': '目标网址'}

首先，我需要解析关键信息：
1. A：数学家兼计算机科学家，父母犹太裔，分别入籍波兰和德国
2. B：著名科学家，48岁时访问中国和日本，30年后获得诺贝尔奖
3. 关系：A师从B

1. 科学家B的身份：48岁访问中国和日本，30年后获诺贝尔奖
2. 数学家兼计算机科学家A的身份：父母犹太裔，分别入籍波兰和德国，师从B
3. 可能的研究领域：数学、计算机科学交叉领域

下一步策略：首先搜索B的相关信息，确定其身份，然后寻找其学生中符合A描述的人。</report>

<think>
上一轮行动使用了jina_search搜索"48岁访问中国和日本 30年后获得诺贝尔奖 科学家"，但搜索结果主要是Instagram、YouTube等社交媒体内容，没有直接找到目标科学家B。搜索结果中提到了"2022年度邵逸夫天文学奖获得者"、"日本学者连获两项诺贝尔奖"、"杨振宁"等，但都没有直接匹配"48岁访问中国和日本，30年后获得诺贝尔奖"这一具体描述。

需要重新分析线索：
1. 科学家B在48岁时访问中国和日本
2. 30年后获得诺贝尔奖
3. B是著名科学家，其学生A是数学家兼计算机科学家

考虑到诺贝尔奖通常颁发给物理学、化学、生理学或医学、文学、和平、经济学领域的成就。数学家兼计算机科学家A可能属于计算机科学或数学领域，但诺贝尔奖没有数学奖。不过，计算机科学领域有图灵奖，但问题明确提到诺贝尔奖。

可能的情况：
- B可能是物理学或化学领域的诺贝尔奖得主
- A可能是B的学生，后来成为数学家兼计算机科学家
- 父母均为犹太裔，分别入籍波兰和德国，这暗示A可能有复杂的移民背景

需要更精确地搜索。尝试搜索"48岁访问中国日本 诺贝尔奖"或"访问中国日本 48岁 诺贝尔奖得主"。

# Nobel Prize laureates by age

This list shows the Nobel Prize laureates by age at the year of the award.

### [Nobel Peace Prize 2014](https://www.nobelprize.org/prizes/peace/2014/summary/)

[Malala Yousafzai](https://www.nobelprize.org/prizes/peace/2014/yousafzai/facts/)

 Awarded at age 17 

> “for their struggle against the suppression of children and young people and for the right of all children to education”

### [Nobel Peace Prize 2018](https://www.nobelprize.org/prizes/peace/2018/summary/)

[Nadia Murad](https://www.nobelprize.org/prizes/peace/2018/murad/facts/)

 Awarded at age 25 

> “for their efforts to end the use of sexual violence as a weapon of war and armed conflict”

### [Nobel Prize in Physics 1915](https://www.nobelprize.org/prizes/physics/1915/summary/)

[Lawrence Bragg](https://www.nobelprize.org/prizes/physics/1915/wl-bragg/facts/)

 Awarded at age 25 

> “for their services in the analysis of crystal structure by means of X-rays”

### [Nobel Prize in Physics 1957](https://www.nobelprize.org/prizes/physics/1957/summary/)

[Tsung-Dao Lee](https://www.nobelprize.org/prizes/physics/1957/lee/facts/)

 Awarded at age 30 

> “for their penetrating investigation of the so-called parity laws which has led to important discoveries regarding the elementary particles”

### [Nobel Prize in Physics 1936](https://www.nobelprize.org/prizes/physics/1936/summary/)

[Carl D. Anderson](https://www.nobelprize.org/prizes/physics/1936/anderson/facts/)

 Awarded at age 31 

> “for his discovery of the positron”

### [Nobel Prize in Physics 1933](https://www.nobelprize.org/prizes/physics/1933/summary/)

[Paul A.M. Dirac](https://www.nobelprize.org/prizes/physics/1933/dirac/facts/)

 Awarded at age 31 

> “for the discovery of new productive forms of atomic theory”

### [Nobel Prize in Physics 1932](https://www.nobelprize.org/prizes/physics/1932/summary/)

[Werner Heisenberg](https://www.nobelprize.org/prizes/physics/1932/heisenberg/facts/)

 Awarded at age 31 

> “for the creation of quantum mechanics, the application of which has, inter alia, led to the discovery of the allotropic forms of hydrogen”

### [Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine 1923](https://www.nobelprize.org/prizes/medicine/1923/summary/)

[Frederick G. Banting](https://www.nobelprize.org/prizes/medicine/1923/banting/facts/)

 Awarded at age 31 

> “for the discovery of insulin”

### [Nobel Peace Prize 2011](https://www.nobelprize.org/prizes/peace/2011/summary/)

[Tawakkol Karman](https://www.nobelprize.org/prizes/peace/2011/karman/facts/)

 Awarded at age 32 

> “for their non-violent struggle for the safety of women and for women's rights to full participation in peace-building work”

### [Nobel Prize in Physics 1961](https://www.nobelprize.org/prizes/physics/1961/summary/)

[Rudolf Mössbauer](https://www.nobelprize.org/prizes/physics/1961/mossbauer/facts/)

 Awarded at age 32 

> “for his researches concerning the resonance absorption of gamma radiation and his discovery in this connection of the effect which bears his name”

# Nobel Prize laureates by age

This list shows the Nobel Prize laureates by age at the year of the award.

### [Nobel Peace Prize 2014](https://www.nobelprize.org/prizes/peace/2014/summary/)

[Malala Yousafzai](https://www.nobelprize.org/prizes/peace/2014/yousafzai/facts/)

 Awarded at age 17 

> “for their struggle against the suppression of children and young people and for the right of all children to education”

### [Nobel Peace Prize 2018](https://www.nobelprize.org/prizes/peace/2018/summary/)

[Nadia Murad](https://www.nobelprize.org/prizes/peace/2018/murad/facts/)

 Awarded at age 25 

> “for their efforts to end the use of sexual violence as a weapon of war and armed conflict”

### [Nobel Prize in Physics 1915](https://www.nobelprize.org/prizes/physics/1915/summary/)

[Lawrence Bragg](https://www.nobelprize.org/prizes/physics/1915/wl-bragg/facts/)

 Awarded at age 25 

> “for their services in the analysis of crystal structure by means of X-rays”

### [Nobel Prize in Physics 1957](https://www.nobelprize.org/prizes/physics/1957/summary/)

[Tsung-Dao Lee](https://www.nobelprize.org/prizes/physics/1957/lee/facts/)

 Awarded at age 30 

> “for their penetrating investigation of the so-called parity laws which has led to important discoveries regarding the elementary particles”

### [Nobel Prize in Physics 1936](https://www.nobelprize.org/prizes/physics/1936/summary/)

[Carl D. Anderson](https://www.nobelprize.org/prizes/physics/1936/anderson/facts/)

 Awarded at age 31 

> “for his discovery of the positron”

### [Nobel Prize in Physics 1933](https://www.nobelprize.org/prizes/physics/1933/summary/)

[Paul A.M. Dirac](https://www.nobelprize.org/prizes/physics/1933/dirac/facts/)

 Awarded at age 31 

> “for the discovery of new productive forms of atomic theory”

### [Nobel Prize in Physics 1932](https://www.nobelprize.org/prizes/physics/1932/summary/)

[Werner Heisenberg](https://www.nobelprize.org/prizes/physics/1932/heisenberg/facts/)

 Awarded at age 31 

> “for the creation of quantum mechanics, the application of which has, inter alia, led to the discovery of the allotropic forms of hydrogen”

### [Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine 1923](https://www.nobelprize.org/prizes/medicine/1923/summary/)

[Frederick G. Banting](https://www.nobelprize.org/prizes/medicine/1923/banting/facts/)

 Awarded at age 31 

> “for the discovery of insulin”

### [Nobel Peace Prize 2011](https://www.nobelprize.org/prizes/peace/2011/summary/)

[Tawakkol Karman](https://www.nobelprize.org/prizes/peace/2011/karman/facts/)

 Awarded at age 32 

> “for their non-violent struggle for the safety of women and for women's rights to full participation in peace-building work”

### [Nobel Prize in Physics 1961](https://www.nobelprize.org/prizes/physics/1961/summary/)

[Rudolf Mössbauer](https://www.nobelprize.org/prizes/physics/1961/mossbauer/facts/)

 Awarded at age 32 

> “for his researches concerning the resonance absorption of gamma radiation and his discovery in this connection of the effect which bears his name”
